task.body:
## Problem
`_term_spans` (`app/intake/journal_club.py`) compiles `re.escape(term)` without word boundaries, so ordinary orchid text triggers technique candidates: the transcript `We surveyed the epiphytic flora of Ecuador at monthly intervals.` yields a `FINE_TUNING` candidate from the term `lora`.

## Required behaviour
- Terms match only when not preceded or followed by a word character: `(?<!\w)` + escaped term + `(?!\w)`, case-insensitive.
- `parse_journal_club_transcript(title="Episode 12", transcript="We surveyed the epiphytic flora of Ecuador at monthly intervals.")` returns `[]`.
- `We fine-tuned with LoRA adapters.` still yields `FINE_TUNING` with exact text `LoRA`.
- Span ordering and all other fields are unchanged; existing tests are unchanged.

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `app/intake/journal_club.py`
- `tests/test_journal_club_intelligence.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_journal_club_intelligence.py`
- `python -m ruff check app/intake/journal_club.py tests/test_journal_club_intelligence.py`

New tests must cover:
- `flora` yields no candidate;
- `LoRA` as a word still matches;
- `medievals` does not match the term `evals`.
